title: Cipher and Ghost
author: Felix Ashgrove
blurb: Silas Vane, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
